meaning_en: as stated by or reported by
example_en: According to the news, it will rain tomorrow.
examples_extra: According to the forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
According to her, the meeting starts at nine.
note_fa: «یعنی «به گفتهٔ/طبق»؛ بعدش منبع: according to the news.»

meaning_en: disagreeing with something or someone
example_en: Many people are against the new law.
examples_extra: Most people voted against the new law.
She is against testing products on animals.

meaning_en: to share the same idea or belief
example_en: We both agree on the plan.
examples_extra: I agree with you on this point.
Experts agree that exercise is good for health.
note_fa: ساختار: agree with + شخص یا نظر.

meaning_en: Used to emphasize a negative statement.
example_en: I don't like coffee at all.
examples_extra: I don't like coffee at all; I prefer tea.

note_fa: بیشتر در جمله‌های منفی و سؤالی می‌آید.

meaning_en: A strong feeling that something is true.
example_en: His belief in freedom is strong.
examples_extra: It is my belief that hard work always pays off.

meaning_en: To think something is true or real.
example_en: I believe his story is true.
examples_extra: I believe the news about the new airport is true.

meaning_en: Really dislike something or someone.
example_en: I can't stand loud music.
examples_extra: Charlotte loves classical music, but she can’t stand opera.

note_fa: یعنی اصلاً خوشش نیامدن؛ قوی‌تر از dislike است.

meaning_en: Loyal and dedicated to a belief or person.

examples_extra: She is a committed teacher who loves her job.

note_fa: با to می‌آید: committed to a cause = پایبند.

meaning_en: Not liking change; traditional in views.

meaning_en: A strong belief or opinion.

examples_extra: She spoke with deep conviction about her plans.

note_fa: دو معنا دارد: «باور عمیق» و «محکومیت قضایی».

meaning_en: To make someone believe something is true.
example_en: I tried to convince him to come.
examples_extra: I convinced my father to buy a new car.
She finally convinced them to join the trip.
note_fa: «قانع کردن»؛ convince somebody to do something.

meaning_en: (n) A supporter of Darwin's theory of evolution. (adj) Relating to Darwinism.
example_en: He is a strong Darwinist, believing in natural selection.
examples_extra: The Darwinist view explains how species change over time.

meaning_en: Working hard and giving a lot of time to something.

examples_extra: She is a dedicated teacher who stays after class.

note_fa: با to می‌آید: dedicated to her work؛ یعنی فداکار/متعهد.

meaning_en: To have a different opinion.

examples_extra: I completely disagree with his opinion on this topic.

meaning_en: To not believe something is true or likely.

examples_extra: I doubt that he will come to the party.

note_fa: یعنی شک داشتن؛ با that می‌آید: I doubt that…

meaning_en: Slightly strange or unusual in a funny way.

examples_extra: Her eccentric uncle collects old bicycles.

meaning_en: Very great or severe; far from average.

meaning_en: Having extreme and unreasonable beliefs or enthusiasm.

meaning_en: To experience a physical sensation.

meaning_en: To have an opinion or belief.

meaning_en: A company or business.

meaning_en: Used to ask someone's opinion on a topic.

meaning_en: A set of beliefs or ideas, especially political ones.

meaning_en: Used to express what you think.

meaning_en: Relating to the mind and thinking.

meaning_en: Political ideas supporting equality and social change.

meaning_en: keep something in good condition.

meaning_en: Not extreme; moderate or average.

meaning_en: A person who follows the religion of Islam.

meaning_en: This is what I think or believe.

meaning_en: Strange or unusual.

meaning_en: To some extent, but not completely.

meaning_en: Relating to a particular person, not public.

meaning_en: Speaking for myself; in my opinion.

meaning_en: The study of knowledge, values, and existence.

meaning_en: An idea or opinion you want to share.

meaning_en: To think or believe something.

meaning_en: Believing in a religion; connected to religion.

meaning_en: Supporting conservative or traditional political views.

meaning_en: Having great power or force.

meaning_en: Very strange and unusual, sometimes a bit scary.

meaning_en: asking for an opinion

meaning_en: To stick firmly to a belief or rule.

meaning_en: Someone who supports a particular party, idea, or set of beliefs.

meaning_en: Able to be believed; trustworthy and convincing.

meaning_en: A person with extreme and uncritical enthusiasm for something.

meaning_en: To agree with someone or something.
